sigma_rule.description: Detects execution from an Alternate Data Stream (ADS). Adversaries may use NTFS file attributes to hide their malicious data in order to evade detection
sigma_rule.name: Execute From Alternate Data Streams

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and dir_path contains 'C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\' and ((file_name endswith 'poweshell.exe' or file_name endswith 'pwsh.exe' or file_name endswith 'rundll32.exe' or file_name endswith 'regsvr32.exe' or file_name endswith 'mshta.exe' or file_name endswith 'cscript.exe' or file_name endswith 'wscript.exe') or (_CommandLine contains 'cmd /c' or _CommandLine contains 'Invoke-' or _CommandLine contains 'Base64'))

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _CommandLine, _ParentCommandLine
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _CommandLine contains '.SettingContent-ms' and (not(_CommandLine contains 'immersivecontrolpanel'))

sigma_rule.description: The .SettingContent-ms file type was introduced in Windows 10 and allows a user to create "shortcuts" to various Windows 10 setting pages. These files are simply XML and contain paths to various Windows 10 settings binaries.
sigma_rule.name: Arbitrary Shell Command Execution Via Settingcontent-Ms

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (file_parent_name endswith 'Winrar.exe' or file_parent_name endswith '7zFM.exe' or file_parent_name endswith 'peazip.exe') and (file_name endswith 'isoburn.exe' or file_name endswith 'PowerISO.exe' or file_name endswith 'ImgBurn.exe')

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_CommandLine contains '.doc' or _CommandLine contains '.docx' or _CommandLine contains '.xls' or _CommandLine contains '.xlsx' or _CommandLine contains '.ppt' or _CommandLine contains '.pptx' or _CommandLine contains '.rtf' or _CommandLine contains '.pdf' or _CommandLine contains '.txt') and ((_CommandLine has_all ('dir ', ' /b ', ' /s ')) or (file_name =~ 'FINDSTR.EXE' and (_CommandLine contains ' /e ' or _CommandLine contains ' /si ')))

sigma_rule.description: Once established within a system or network, an adversary may use automated techniques for collecting internal data.
sigma_rule.name: Automated Collection Command Prompt

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _fileParentName, _ParentCommandLine
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((file_name endswith 'WerFault.exe' and _CommandLine endswith 'WerFault.exe') or (file_name endswith 'rundll32.exe' and _CommandLine endswith 'rundll32.exe') or (file_name endswith 'regsvcs.exe' and _CommandLine endswith 'regsvcs.exe') or (file_name endswith 'regasm.exe' and _CommandLine endswith 'regasm.exe') or (file_name endswith 'regsvr32.exe' and _CommandLine endswith 'regsvr32.exe')) and (not((dir_path startswith 'C:\\Users\\' and (file_parent_name startswith '{' and dir_path endswith '\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\EdgeUpdate\\Install') and file_parent_name endswith 'setup.exe' and _ParentCommandLine contains '\\setup.exe" --install-archive="C:\\Users\\')))

sigma_rule.description:
Detects attackers using tooling with bad opsec defaults.
E.g. spawning a sacrificial process to inject a capability into the process without taking into account how the process is normally run.
One trivial example of this is using rundll32.exe without arguments as a sacrificial process (default in CS, now highlighted by c2lint), running WerFault without arguments (Kraken - credit am0nsec), and other examples.

detection.condition: 1 of selection* and not 1 of filter*

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_CommandLine contains '\\calc.exe ' or (file_name endswith 'calc.exe' and (not((dir_path startswith 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\' or dir_path startswith 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\' or dir_path startswith 'C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\')))))

sigma_rule.description: Detects suspicious use of 'calc.exe' with command line parameters or in a suspicious directory, which is likely caused by some PoC or detection evasion

detection.condition: selection_1 or ( selection_2 and not filter_2 )

sigma_rule.name: Suspicious Calculator Usage

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_CommandLine contains 'h^t^t^p' or _CommandLine contains 'h"t"t"p')

sigma_rule.description: Detects potential commandline obfuscation using known escape characters
sigma_rule.name: Potential Commandline Obfuscation Using Escape Characters

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_CommandLine contains 'ˣ' or _CommandLine contains '˪' or _CommandLine contains 'ˢ') or (_CommandLine contains '∕' or _CommandLine contains '⁄') or (_CommandLine contains '―' or _CommandLine contains '—') or (_CommandLine contains 'â' or _CommandLine contains '€' or _CommandLine contains '£' or _CommandLine contains '¯' or _CommandLine contains '®' or _CommandLine contains 'µ' or _CommandLine contains '¶'))

Detects potential commandline obfuscation using unicode characters.
Adversaries may attempt to make an executable or file difficult to discover or analyze by encrypting, encoding, or otherwise obfuscating its contents on the system or in transit.
sigma_rule.name: Potential Commandline Obfuscation Using Unicode Characters

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((dir_path contains '\\Windows\\' and (_CommandLine contains '\\..\\Windows\\' or _CommandLine contains '\\..\\System32\\' or _CommandLine contains '\\..\\..\\')) or _CommandLine contains '.exe\\..\\') and (not((_CommandLine contains '\\Google\\Drive\\googledrivesync.exe\\..\\' or _CommandLine contains '\\Citrix\\Virtual Smart Card\\Citrix.Authentication.VirtualSmartcard.Launcher.exe\\..\\')))

detection.condition: 1 of selection_* and not 1 of filter_optional_*

sigma_rule.name: Potential Command Line Path Traversal Evasion Attempt

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ("strcat(dir_path, file_name)" matches regex '7z.*\.exe' and (_CommandLine contains ' -p' or _CommandLine contains ' -ta' or _CommandLine contains ' -tb' or _CommandLine contains ' -sdel' or _CommandLine contains ' -dw' or _CommandLine contains ' -hp')) and (not((file_parent_name startswith 'Program' and dir_path =~ 'C:')))

sigma_rule.description: Detects suspicious command line arguments of common data compression tools
sigma_rule.name: Suspicious Compression Tool Parameters

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_CommandLine contains 'copy-item' or _CommandLine contains 'copy ' or _CommandLine contains 'cpi ' or _CommandLine contains ' cp ' or _CommandLine contains 'move ' or _CommandLine contains 'move-item' or _CommandLine contains ' mi ' or _CommandLine contains ' mv ') or (file_name endswith 'xcopy.exe' or file_name endswith 'robocopy.exe') or (file_name in~ ('XCOPY.EXE', 'robocopy.exe'))) and (_CommandLine contains '\\Opera Software\\Opera Stable\\' or _CommandLine contains '\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles' or _CommandLine contains '\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data\\' or _CommandLine contains '\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\')

Web browsers typically store the credentials in an encrypted format within a credential store.

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _CommandLine, _ParentCommandLine
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_CommandLine has_all ('\\', '$')) or _CommandLine contains '\\Sysvol\\') and (((file_name endswith 'robocopy.exe' or file_name endswith 'xcopy.exe') or (file_name in~ ('robocopy.exe', 'XCOPY.EXE'))) or ((file_name endswith 'cmd.exe' or file_name =~ 'Cmd.Exe') and _CommandLine contains 'copy') or (((file_name contains 'powershell.exe' or file_name contains 'pwsh.exe') or (file_name in~ ('PowerShell.EXE', 'pwsh.dll'))) and (_CommandLine contains 'copy-item' or _CommandLine contains 'copy ' or _CommandLine contains 'cpi ' or _CommandLine contains ' cp ' or _CommandLine contains 'move ' or _CommandLine contains 'move-item' or _CommandLine contains ' mi ' or _CommandLine contains ' mv ')))

sigma_rule.description: Detects a suspicious copy command to or from an Admin share or remote

detection.condition: selection_target and (selection_other_tools or all of selection_cmd_* or all of selection_pwsh_*)

sigma_rule.name: Copy from Admin Share

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _CommandLine, _ParentCommandLine
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((file_name endswith 'cmd.exe' and _CommandLine contains 'copy ') or ((file_name endswith 'powershell.exe' or file_name endswith 'pwsh.exe') and (_CommandLine contains 'copy-item' or _CommandLine contains ' copy ' or _CommandLine contains 'cpi ' or _CommandLine contains ' cp ')) or ((file_name endswith 'robocopy.exe' or file_name endswith 'xcopy.exe') or (file_name in~ ('robocopy.exe', 'XCOPY.EXE')))) and (_CommandLine contains '\\System32' or _CommandLine contains '\\SysWOW64')

sigma_rule.description: Detects command line parameters or strings often used by crypto miners

pysigma_kql:
events_all

sigma_rule.description: Detects the use of various CLI utilities exfiltrating data via web requests

detection.condition: (selection_iwr or all of selection_curl* or selection_wget) and payloads

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_CommandLine has_all ('taskkill ', 'RaccineSettings.exe')) or (_CommandLine has_all ('reg.exe', 'delete', 'Raccine Tray')) or (_CommandLine has_all ('schtasks', '/DELETE', 'Raccine Rules Updater')))

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (file_name endswith '.doc.exe' or file_name endswith '.docx.exe' or file_name endswith '.xls.exe' or file_name endswith '.xlsx.exe' or file_name endswith '.ppt.exe' or file_name endswith '.pptx.exe' or file_name endswith '.rtf.exe' or file_name endswith '.pdf.exe' or file_name endswith '.txt.exe' or file_name endswith '      .exe' or file_name endswith '______.exe' or file_name endswith '.doc.js' or file_name endswith '.docx.js' or file_name endswith '.xls.js' or file_name endswith '.xlsx.js' or file_name endswith '.ppt.js' or file_name endswith '.pptx.js' or file_name endswith '.rtf.js' or file_name endswith '.pdf.js' or file_name endswith '.txt.js') and (_CommandLine contains '.doc.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.docx.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.xls.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.xlsx.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.ppt.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.pptx.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.rtf.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.pdf.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.txt.exe' or _CommandLine contains '      .exe' or _CommandLine contains '______.exe' or _CommandLine contains '.doc.js' or _CommandLine contains '.docx.js' or _CommandLine contains '.xls.js' or _CommandLine contains '.xlsx.js' or _CommandLine contains '.ppt.js' or _CommandLine contains '.pptx.js' or _CommandLine contains '.rtf.js' or _CommandLine contains '.pdf.js' or _CommandLine contains '.txt.js')

sigma_rule.name: Suspicious Double Extension File Execution

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((file_parent_name endswith '.doc.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.docx.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.xls.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.xlsx.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.ppt.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.pptx.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.rtf.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.pdf.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.txt.lnk' or file_parent_name endswith '.doc.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.docx.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.xls.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.xlsx.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.ppt.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.pptx.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.rtf.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.pdf.js' or file_parent_name endswith '.txt.js') or (_ParentCommandLine contains '.doc.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.docx.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.xls.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.xlsx.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.ppt.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.pptx.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.rtf.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.pdf.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.txt.lnk' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.doc.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.docx.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.xls.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.xlsx.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.ppt.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.pptx.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.rtf.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.pdf.js' or _ParentCommandLine contains '.txt.js'))

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (((file_name endswith 'curl.exe' or file_name endswith 'wget.exe') or (_CommandLine contains 'Invoke-WebRequest' or _CommandLine contains 'iwr ' or _CommandLine contains 'curl ' or _CommandLine contains 'wget ' or _CommandLine contains 'Start-BitsTransfer' or _CommandLine contains '.DownloadFile(' or _CommandLine contains '.DownloadString(')) and (_CommandLine contains 'https://attachment.outlook.live.net/owa/' or _CommandLine contains 'https://onenoteonlinesync.onenote.com/onenoteonlinesync/'))

pysigma_kql:

sigma_rule.description:
An adversary might use WMI to check if a certain remote service is running on a remote device.
When the test completes, a service information will be displayed on the screen if it exists.
A common feedback message is that "No instance(s) Available" if the service queried is not running.
A common error message is "Node - (provided IP or default) ERROR Description =The RPC server is unavailable" if the provided remote host is unreachable
sigma_rule.name: Service Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_Description =~ 'WMI Commandline Utility' or file_name =~ 'wmic.exe' or file_name endswith 'WMIC.exe') and (_CommandLine contains 'baseboard get product' or _CommandLine contains 'baseboard get version' or _CommandLine contains 'bios get SMBIOSBIOSVersion' or _CommandLine contains 'cpu get name' or _CommandLine contains 'DISKDRIVE get Caption' or _CommandLine contains 'LOGICALDISK get Name,Size,FreeSpace' or _CommandLine contains 'MEMPHYSICAL get MaxCapacity' or _CommandLine contains 'OS get Caption,OSArchitecture,Version' or _CommandLine contains 'path win32_VideoController get DriverVersion' or _CommandLine contains 'path win32_VideoController get name' or _CommandLine contains 'path win32_VideoController get VideoModeDescription')

sigma_rule.description:
Detects the use of the WMI command-line (WMIC) utility to identify and display various system information,
including OS, CPU, GPU, and disk drive names; memory capacity; display resolution; and baseboard, BIOS,
and GPU driver products/versions.
Some of these commands were used by Aurora Stealer in late 2022/early 2023.
sigma_rule.name: Potential System Information Discovery Via Wmic.EXE

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (file_name =~ 'wmic.exe' or file_name endswith 'WMIC.exe') and (_CommandLine has_all (' service get ', 'name,displayname,pathname,startmode'))

sigma_rule.description: Detects known WMI recon method to look for unquoted service paths using wmic. Often used by pentester and attacker enumeration scripts
sigma_rule.name: Potential Unquoted Service Path Reconnaissance Via Wmic.EXE

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((file_name endswith 'WMIC.exe' or file_name =~ 'wmic.exe') and _CommandLine contains '/node:') and (not((_CommandLine contains '/node:127.0.0.1 ' or _CommandLine contains '/node:localhost ')))

sigma_rule.description: Detects the execution of WMIC to query information on a remote system

detection.condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_*

sigma_rule.name: WMIC Remote Command Execution

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (file_name =~ 'wmic.exe' or file_name endswith 'WMIC.exe') and ((_CommandLine has_all (' service ', ' call ')) and (_CommandLine contains 'stopservice' or _CommandLine contains 'startservice'))

sigma_rule.description: Detects usage of wmic to start or stop a service
sigma_rule.name: Service Started/Stopped Via Wmic.EXE

pysigma_kql:

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (file_name endswith 'WMIC.exe' or file_name =~ 'wmic.exe') and (_CommandLine contains 'call' or _CommandLine contains 'uninstall')

pysigma_kql:

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and file_parent_name endswith 'WmiPrvSE.exe' and ((file_name endswith 'powershell.exe' or file_name endswith 'pwsh.exe') or (file_name in~ ('PowerShell.EXE', 'pwsh.dll')))

pysigma_kql:

pysigma_kql:

sigma_rule.description:
Detects when an attacker modifies values of the Disk Cleanup Handler in the registry to achieve persistence.
The disk cleanup manager is part of the operating system. It displays the dialog box […]
The user has the option of enabling or disabling individual handlers by selecting or clearing their check box in the disk cleanup manager's UI.
Although Windows comes with a number of disk cleanup handlers, they aren't designed to handle files produced by other applications.
Instead, the disk cleanup manager is designed to be flexible and extensible by enabling any developer to implement and register their own disk cleanup handler.
Any developer can extend the available disk cleanup services by implementing and registering a disk cleanup handler.
sigma_rule.name: Potential Persistence Via Disk Cleanup Handler - Registry

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _EventType =~ 'DeleteKey' and (_TargetObject has_all ('\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Schedule\\TaskCache\\Tree\\', 'SD'))

sigma_rule.description: Remove SD (Security Descriptor) value in \Schedule\TaskCache\Tree registry hive to hide schedule task. This technique is used by Tarrask malware
sigma_rule.name: Removal Of SD Value to Hide Schedule Task - Registry

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject contains '\\SAM\\SAM\\Domains\\Account\\Users\\Names\\' and _TargetObject endswith '$' and file_name endswith 'lsass.exe'

sigma_rule.description: Sysmon registry detection of a local hidden user account.

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject =~ 'HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\ntkd'

events_all

pysigma_kql:
events_all

| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject contains '\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\services\\null\\Instance'

sigma_rule.description: Detects Pandemic Windows Implant

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _fileName, _EventType, _TargetObject
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject endswith '\\AppX82a6gwre4fdg3bt635tn5ctqjf8msdd2\\Shell\\open\\command'

events_all
| project _CommandLine, _ParentCommandLine
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject contains '\\cmmgr32.exe'

sigma_rule.description: Detects various indicators of Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer execution
sigma_rule.name: CMSTP Execution Registry Event

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject endswith '\\IsCredGuardEnabled'

Detects potential malicious modification of the property value of IsCredGuardEnabled from
HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest to disable Cred Guard on a system.
This is usually used with UseLogonCredential to manipulate the caching credentials.
sigma_rule.name: Wdigest CredGuard Registry Modification

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_TargetObject contains 'System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\VSS' and file_name endswith 'esentutl.exe') and (not(_TargetObject contains 'System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\VSS\\Start'))

sigma_rule.description: Detects the volume shadow copy service initialization and processing via esentutl. Registry keys such as HKLM\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\VSS\\Diag\\VolSnap\\Volume are captured.

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject contains 'Services\\WCESERVICE\\Start'

sigma_rule.description: Detects the use of Windows Credential Editor (WCE)

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _fileName, _TargetObject
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and (_EventID in ('12', '13')) and _TargetObject contains 'SYSTEM\\' and _TargetObject endswith '\\services\\localNETService'

sigma_rule.description: Detects the presence of a registry key created during Azorult execution

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_TargetObject in~ ('HKLM\\HARDWARE\\{804423C2-F490-4ac3-BFA5-13DEDE63A71A}', 'HKLM\\HARDWARE\\{A5124AF5-DF23-49bf-B0ED-A18ED3DEA027}', 'HKLM\\HARDWARE\\{2DB80286-1784-48b5-A751-B6ED1F490303}')) or _TargetObject startswith 'HKLM\\SYSTEM\\Setup\\PrintResponsor\\')

sigma_rule.description: Detects FlowCloud malware from threat group TA410.

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject endswith '\\Software\\firm\\soft\\Name'

sigma_rule.description: Detects a registry key used by IceID in a campaign that distributes malicious OneNote files
sigma_rule.name: Potential Qakbot Registry Activity

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and ((_TargetObject contains '\\Control\\Print\\Environments\\Windows x64\\Drivers\\Version-3\\QMS 810\\' or _TargetObject contains '\\Control\\Print\\Environments\\Windows x64\\Drivers\\Version-3\\mimikatz') or (_TargetObject has_all ('legitprinter', '\\Control\\Print\\Environments\\Windows')) or ((_TargetObject contains '\\Control\\Print\\Environments' or _TargetObject contains '\\CurrentVersion\\Print\\Printers') and (_TargetObject contains 'Gentil Kiwi' or _TargetObject contains 'mimikatz printer' or _TargetObject contains 'Kiwi Legit Printer')))

detection.condition: selection or selection_alt or (selection_print and selection_kiwi)

events_all

events_all

sigma_rule.description: Detects NetNTLM downgrade attack

events_all

sigma_rule.name: Windows Registry Trust Record Modification

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject =~ 'HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\PortProxy\\v4tov4\\tcp'

sigma_rule.description: Detects the modification of PortProxy registry key which is used for port forwarding. For command execution see rule win_netsh_port_fwd.yml.

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _TargetObject contains 'HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\HTMLHelp\\data'

sigma_rule.name: RedMimicry Winnti Playbook Registry Manipulation

pysigma_kql:
events_all
| project _fileName, _EventType, _TargetObject

pysigma_kql:
events_all

events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _EventType =~ 'SetValue' and _TargetObject startswith 'HKCR\\ms-msdt\\'

events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _EventType =~ 'SetValue' and _TargetObject contains '\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions'

events_all
| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _EventType =~ 'Setvalue' and (_TargetObject endswith '\\Services\\DHCPServer\\Parameters\\CalloutDlls' or _TargetObject endswith '\\Services\\DHCPServer\\Parameters\\CalloutEnabled')

| where data_source_type_id == 12 and _EventType =~ 'Setvalue' and (_TargetObject endswith '\\COR_ENABLE_PROFILING' or _TargetObject endswith '\\COR_PROFILER')
